description: HW1-PIPE-v1 X2: negative and boundary vectors with the P4 outcome. Same synthetic keys as phone_pipe_v1_sessions.json.
generated_by: components/hardwareone/test/host/phone_session_vectors.cpp: production BLE_PhoneGatt.cpp, BLE_PhoneSecureChannel.h and BLE_PhonePipeCore.h on the synthetic SDK in phone_gatt_fake_sdk.h; only the device key, secure nonce and pipe HELLO nonce are fixed

base.handshake: Frames start at the P4 CCCD write of a fresh MTU-247 session (t_ms 0).
base.pipe: Frames continue the MTU-247 session of phone_pipe_v1_sessions.json after the phone pipe HELLO_ACK: phone outer counter 1 and inner sequence 0 are used, P4 counter 1 and inner sequence 0 are used. Unless a vector says otherwise, phone frames use the next counter/seq.
base.transport: No authenticated state; the adapter stops before the CCCD write.

fields.source: p4_production = outcome decided by the production P4 adapter; contract = P4-produced bytes that Android must reject under the agreed rule named in "rule"
fields.p4_sends_hex: values the P4 wrote after the first vector frame (REJECT, replies)
fields.auth_cooldown: the P4 charges its global 30 s authentication cooldown
fields.p4_error: the adapter session end reason: for an authenticated frame the pipe refuses, the core's own cause (a phone RESET's code, Flow, Protocol); Unauthorized only for frames that fail authentication
